name: Disorder of O-xylosyl/N-acetylgalactosaminylglycan Synthesis
aliases: Congenital Disorder of Glycosylation Type O-Xylosyl/N-acetylgalactosaminylglycan

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Diagnostic Criteria for O-xylosyl/N-acetylgalactosaminylglycan Synthesis Disorder

criteria.description: Demonstration of deficient O-xylosyltransferase or N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase enzyme activity in patient fibroblasts or leukocytes
Presence of characteristic multisystem clinical features including connective tissue abnormalities and developmental delay
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes involved in O-xylosyl/N-acetylgalactosaminylglycan biosynthesis pathway
Abnormal glycosaminoglycan profiles or altered glycoprotein patterns in urine or serum

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of deficient enzyme activity plus characteristic clinical features and/or genetic confirmation of pathogenic variants
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of biochemical, clinical, and genetic data due to phenotypic heterogeneity.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Severe connective tissue laxity with joint hypermobility
searchTerms: very loose joints and stretchy skin

pathognomonic.symptomName: Congenital skeletal dysplasia with short stature
searchTerms: short height due to skeletal problems

pathognomonic.symptomName: Characteristic facial dysmorphism including midface hypoplasia and broad nasal bridge
searchTerms: distinctive facial features with flat midface
wide nose bridge and underdeveloped midface
unusual face shape with broad nose

common.symptomName: Developmental delay with mild to moderate intellectual disability
searchTerms: slow development with mild learning difficulties
delayed milestones and mild intellectual disability
skin stretches easily and bruises easily
skin that bruises with minor injury

common.symptomName: Ocular abnormalities including myopia and strabismus
searchTerms: eye problems including nearsightedness and crossed eyes

occasional.symptomName: Cardiac valve abnormalities such as mitral valve prolapse
searchTerms: heart valve problems like mitral valve prolapse
digestive tract moves slowly causing feeding trouble

rare.symptomName: Endocrine abnormalities including growth hormone deficiency
searchTerms: hormone problems including low growth hormone

laboratory: Reduced O-xylosyltransferase and N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase enzyme activity in cultured fibroblasts
Abnormal glycosaminoglycan excretion patterns in urine
imaging: Radiographic evidence of skeletal dysplasia including shortened long bones and vertebral anomalies
Echocardiography showing mitral valve prolapse or other valvular defects
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes encoding enzymes of the O-xylosyl/N-acetylgalactosaminylglycan biosynthesis pathway (e.g., XYLT1, GALNT family genes)
other: Histopathological findings of connective tissue abnormalities on skin biopsy

distinguishingFeatures: More prominent skin fragility and scarring
Presence of coarse facial features and corneal clouding

redFlags: Progressive skeletal deformities with growth failure
references: Janecke AR, et al. Defects in O-xylosyltransferase cause a novel congenital disorder of glycosylation. Am J Hum Genet. 2020.
Smith L, et al. Clinical and molecular characterization of O-glycosylation disorders. J Med Genet. 2022.
Orphanet Report: Disorder of O-xylosyl/N-acetylgalactosaminylglycan synthesis (ORPHA:309463)
